_comment: Evaluation cases for PawPal+ AI. Each case runs the full RAG pipeline (validate → retrieve → generate → guard) for one pet profile and asserts a list of expected behaviors. See eval/run_eval.py for the check registry. Cases 1-6 are happy-path species/life-stage profiles; cases 7-8 are edge cases that exercise the guardrails.

cases.description: Puppy dog (age 0) should get a balanced day plan with short walks, multiple feedings, and grooming practice.

expectations.rationale: Puppy KB has 3 chunks (feeding/exercise/grooming) with 2-3 templates each.
Every suggestion must trace back to a KB doc.
Puppies need scheduled meals.
Puppies need daily activity.
Puppies should get early handling practice.
Puppy walks should be short (5-min-per-month-of-age rule).
A puppy day plan should include at least one walk.

cases.description: Adult dog (age 3) should get walks, two main meals, and routine grooming.

expectations.rationale: Adult dog KB has 3 chunks (feeding/exercise/grooming) with multiple templates.
Every suggestion must trace back to a KB doc.
Adult plans should include at least one physical activity item.

cases.description: Senior dog (age 10) should get gentler/shorter walks and senior-portioned meals. KB has no senior-dog-grooming chunk by design.

expectations.rationale: Senior dog KB has 2 chunks (feeding + exercise).
Senior dog walks should be shorter / lower-impact than adult walks.

cases.description: Adult cat (age 5) should get two measured meals plus interactive play.

expectations.rationale: Adult cat KB has 2 chunks (feeding + play) with 2 templates each.
Adult cats need scheduled play.

cases.description: Senior cat (age 12) should get smaller, more frequent meals (KB only covers feeding for senior cats).

expectations.rationale: Senior cat KB only has 1 chunk (feeding) with 3 templates.
Senior cats benefit from 3+ smaller meals — breakfast, midday, dinner.

cases.description: Adult rabbit should get hay, leafy greens, out-of-cage exercise, and enrichment.

expectations.rationale: Rabbit KB has 3 chunks (feeding/exercise/enrichment).
Hay is the foundation of a rabbit's diet — must appear in the plan.

cases.description: Edge case: hamster is outside the KB. Input validator should reject the call before any retrieval, returning an empty list.

expectations.rationale: Guardrail must refuse to invent suggestions for species outside the KB.

cases.description: Edge case: an age below the minimum should be rejected by the input validator.

expectations.rationale: Guardrail must refuse pets with implausible ages.
